description: Add, subtract, multiply, divide, raise to an integer power, compare, or take a percentage, on decimal STRINGS with exact arithmetic (no floating point). The result is rounded only to the scale and rule you choose, and the response says whether rounding changed the value. JSON numbers are refused because they lose precision. Division by zero is an error.

rounding.description: rounding rule; default half_up (ties away from zero). half_even is banker's rounding

name: decimal_calc
title: Exact decimal arithmetic
